Books

This is a selection of books that cover various subjects related to Qatar.
The comments here are extracts from reviews and comments from editors and readers.
Click on the book title for full details and reviews.

New books:

This Way Gulf States : Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, United Arab Emirates, Oman, Yemen By JPM Publications
Designed to provide the maximum of cultural, historical, and practical information in a minimum space, each guide offers a variety of street, subway, and regional maps.


Recommended reading:

Qatar By Byron Augustin
The book discusses geography, history, religions, culture, economy, and daily life.

Bedouins of Qatar By Klaus Ferdinand

The Ottoman Gulf : The Creation of Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar, 1870-1914 By Frederick Anscombe
.... bases his work on the Ottoman documents and sees the Gulf from the perspective of Instanbul. . . . Excellent.

Qatar Country Review 1999/2000 By Robert Kelly
Up-to-date sources for political and economic information.

Qatar Country Study Guide By USA International Business Publications
This study guide contains basic information on economy, government, business, history and geography, climate, traditions, people, places to visit.

Qatar Investment & Business Guide By Emerging Markets Investment Center
Provides strategic information on economy, industrial development, banking, and government.

Qatar Business Law Handbook By Emerging Markets Investment Center
Contains information on basic business legislation, laws and regulatoins affecting export-import, business, foreign investments, property rights, taxation and banking.

Bahrain, Oman, Qatar and the Uae : Challenges of Security By Anthony Cordesman
Covers the military situation of the Arabian peninsula. This particular volume is divided in sections by country, and covers history, the current military situation, and internal security issues

Oil and Politics in the Gulf : Rulers Merchants in Kuwait and Qatar By Jill Crystal
